requirements.evidence: Migrations match names/columns exactly incl. stored generated owner_seq and `entity_memberships_one_owner` (create_entity_memberships_table.php:21-26); policies per spec (EntityPolicy.php, EntityMembershipPolicy.php:33-39); pick authorizes, writes `Log::channel('audit')`, redirects (EntityController.php:18-27); Members addMember/assignRole (Rule::in manageable)/removeMember with last-manager 403 (Members.php:38-107); Settings save with unique-ignore slug, delete clears session, transfer locks rows, requires admin other than caller, demotes then promotes in a transaction, 403 when owner row vanished (Settings.php:35-102); dashboard hides settings URL via @can (dashboard.blade.php:12-14); routes and lang keys in both locales; docs/database-schema.md updated.

conventions.evidence: Policies used everywhere, `#[Validate]`/rules() + validate(), #[Fillable] on models, Bulma + existing <x-form-field>/<x-button> components, docs and CHANGELOG updated. But domain writes (add member, assign role, remove, transfer, delete entity) are done directly inside Livewire components instead of `app/Actions/*` as the conventions require; CHANGELOG entry also duplicated into the released [0.0.0] section (CHANGELOG.md:39).

security.evidence: Entity properties are `#[Locked]` models; every public action re-authorizes (Members.php:40,74,93; Settings.php:49,62,80); client ids resolved scoped to the entity via `$this->entity->memberships()->find($id)` with FILTER_VALIDATE_INT (Members.php:122-130, Settings.php:84-93); addMember rate limited; all output via {{ }}; no mass-assignment of unvalidated input.

tests.evidence: Six feature test files: data model/DB constraint tests (second owner rejected), policy matrices per role, pick (session untouched on 403, audit channel), members (unauthorized employee, foreign-entity ids tamper, owner not changeable, last manager, swap of bound entity), settings (non-owner denied, entity swap, transfer target kinds, owner row vanished, english locale).

simplicity.evidence: Lean components reusing policies and scopes; small duplication of isManager/role lists between the two policies and Members.php:95 (`whereIn('role', [Owner, Admin])`).

readability.evidence: Clear names, short methods, helpful comments ("Demote first: the unique index allows a single owner at any time."); minor: fully-qualified `\App\Models\UserRole::Owner` inside members.blade.php:23.

scope.evidence: Everything serves the task; out-of-scope items (onboarding, switcher, middleware) not built. The CHANGELOG entry was also added to the already-released [0.0.0] section, an unrelated edit to release history.

issues.explanation: Domain writes (add/assign/remove member, delete entity, ownership transfer) live in Livewire components instead of one `app/Actions/*` class per use case as the conventions require.
The changelog entry is duplicated into the released [0.0.0] section; it belongs only under [Unreleased].
The last-manager count is not done under a lock/transaction, so concurrent removals could race (mitigated because the owner always counts as a manager).
Fully-qualified enum reference in the Blade template; the component could pass this or the view could rely on the policy alone.

review.summary: The change implements the entity data model with DB-enforced single owner, both policies, entity pick with audit logging, and the dashboard/members/settings Livewire pages with locked bound entities, server-side authorization of every action and thorough tests including tamper and unauthorized cases. It fully meets the task; the main deviations are domain writes not going through app/Actions and a CHANGELOG entry duplicated into a released version, so it is approvable with minor changes.
